_comment: PER-MATTER PROFILE (TEMPLATE). This is the only place matter-specific values belong. Copy it OUTSIDE the kit into a live configuration folder that is never archived or moved (for example <MATTER_ROOT>\.codex\legal_matter\), fill every <...> value, and select the copy with the LEGAL_MATTER_PROFILE environment variable or `legal_hooks.py --matter-profile <path>`. Never save a filled copy inside the kit.
client: <the client, as named in the court file>
matter_root: <absolute path of the matter's top folder>
casebook_root: <absolute path of the matter's casebook or record folder>
control_folder: <absolute path of the matter's control documents>
work_root: <working folder for analysis outputs, outside the kit>

playbook.path: <absolute path of the matter's Corrective Playbook>
playbook.reference_opinion: <case name, number, court, and date of the opinion the Playbook was written from>
playbook.literal_rules_file: <optional: literal-mode rules for the reference opinion>
playbook.scope_decision_path: <optional: the owner's dated decision on where the Playbook's literal wording applies (see master-rules.md, Owner scope decision)>

tools.openrouter_key_file: <optional: key file outside the kit; export it as JEV_API_KEY_FILE>
tools.organizer_ledger: <optional: SQLite organizer ledger; export it as LEGAL_KIT_LEDGER>
tools.organizer_python: <optional: organizer tools folder; export it as LEGAL_KIT_ORGANIZER_PYTHON>
tools.fact_purge_systems_map: <optional: the matter's systems map for purge-false-fact (template: skills/purge-false-fact/references/systems-map-template.md)>
tools.fact_occurrence_finder: <optional: read-only helper that searches every store in the systems map>
tools.anytxt_mcp_url: <optional: Anytxt's local MCP endpoint (streamable HTTP), e.g. http://127.0.0.1:9924/mcp; register it in each tool as server 'anytxt'>

knowledge_roots._comment: Optional. Reference knowledge for the governing law, read-only for agents. master-rules.md K14 governs use. role: base_secondary | companion_secondary | background_only. law_change_check_before: chapters dated before this need a law-change check.
knowledge_roots.guide: <optional: agent guide explaining how to search the tiers>

tiers.title: <source title and publisher>
tiers.use: <how it may be used and cited>

transmission.outside_models_authorized: <true | false, with date and who decided>

legal_hooks.state_root: <folder for hook state and audit logs, outside the kit>
legal_hooks._case_fact_retrieval_comment: Optional. Set approved_case_collection to "" to retire MemGraphRAG for this matter, and list the ordered retrieval layers in case_fact_retrieval_order. Omit both to keep the policy default (legal-deepseek).
case_fact_retrieval_order: <optional: first retrieval layer for case facts>
<optional: last layer, e.g. the original file for quotes and pin cites>
